host: the platform on CellB in Node (packages/platform, dist/platform/cellb)

steps.title: A version range redirects to a pinned version
steps.note: The CDN reads the package's packument from the package store (which fetched it from npm) and picks the highest version in the range.

steps.title: The pinned URL is the module, as ESM
steps.note: First request: the tarball is downloaded into the package store and the file transformed. Bare imports are rewritten to same-origin URLs; the answer is immutable.

steps.title: The same URL again
steps.note: Second request: the transformed module comes from the object's SQLite.

steps.title: ?graph lists every module an entry needs
steps.note: A page can put these in <link rel=modulepreload> and load the whole graph in one round of requests.

steps.title: A stylesheet as a module
steps.note: ?module answers CSS with a module that adds it to the document, so `import "…css?module"` works in a page. Lightning CSS processes it first.

steps.title: The browser profile: nanoid
steps.note: /npm/browser/ resolves with the browser conditions: nanoid's browser build, which uses crypto.getRandomValues.

steps.title: The node profile: nanoid
steps.note: /npm/node/ resolves with the node conditions: nanoid's Node build, whose node:crypto import is left for the runtime (a Worker with nodejs_compat, Deno, Node).
